run_notes_crud_test: run the notes CRUD test suite against a launched server executable and host
test_call_endpoints: test the notes API endpoints by creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes
check_response_status: check an HTTP response and raise an error if the status code is 400 or higher
generate_random_string: generate a random 16-character hexadecimal string for unique test data
launch_server_and_test: launch a server with credentials and run endpoint tests against the listening port
